Supported dispatch: review may now contain prerequisiteFor:[checkpointId,...], with [] for ordinary reviews (legacy omitted fields remain accepted). For T3.1.2e.1c.1 create one NEW gated checkpoint, choose its bounded actual contract paths/reason/evidenceIds, and put the exact complete set of CURRENTLY INCOMPLETE critical checkpoint IDs in prerequisiteFor. Use one verifier assignment with repair:null and bounded allowedFiles, and optionally its matching read-only auditor in a later execution group. Do not include any other writable assignment, including a writer on an old checkpoint. The matching auditor repeats the entire review context including prerequisiteFor and runs only after passing current-target verifier evidence. The runtime registers this new checkpoint before execution and stores real run-bound acceptance receipts through the existing review flow. Do not manufacture receipts or substitute this controller verification for the independent target-project contract review.

Preserve the existing immutable checkpoints, especially m4-t312e1-dispatch-stop-evidence; derive the incomplete set from actual current gate state rather than assuming every stored checkpoint is pending. Accepted prerequisite review does not satisfy any original checkpoint. Unrelated writers and finish remain gated, unknown targets fail closed, and all required current-target verifier/auditor receipts remain mandatory. Independent review initially found a same-checkpoint co-dispatched writer bypass; it is fixed and covered by a regression. Independent critic approved the final admission and runtime identity. Durable contract: controlling repository docs/adr/prerequisite-review-admission.md.

Resume the independent T3.1.2e.1c.1 prerequisite review using this supported admission and then continue only tasks whose prerequisites are accepted. Controller access failures from sandboxed workers do not refute this externally verified loaded-runtime evidence. I am monitoring this task via A2A in the owner's current session and can resolve further controller implementation blockers. M4 remains pending.
